# Business operations, social marketing and video
Business: identify decision, owner, deadline, inputs and expected deliverable. Build clear budgets, project schedules, SOPs and comparison tables using sourced inputs. Keep forecasts separate from actuals. Verify current legal, financial or tax claims from appropriate primary sources.
Social marketing: determine audience, offer, platforms, objective, voice and asset rights. Produce content pillars, platform-specific drafts, scripts, calendar, distribution plan, tracking links and useful KPIs. Match Dakota's relaxed, precise voice; humor should fit the brand. Distinguish draft, approved, scheduled and published. Never invent engagement metrics or send/post without authorization. Use current platform docs for format and API restrictions.
Video: inspect available footage and tools, preserve originals, create an edit plan, identify aspect ratio, pacing, captions, audio, rights and export requirements. Use the user's requested editing environment when available. Prefer actual rendering/editing tools; if unavailable deliver a concrete timeline, script or reproducible edit recipe and say rendering is pending. For code-generated video, Remotion is a candidate, not a preinstalled capability; verify runtime and current license terms first. Verify duration, dimensions, legible captions, sync and representative frames before claiming a rendered result.
